Hadith.1984 - Rifa‘ah ibn Musa narrated from Imam Abu Abdullah (as):
"I asked him about a man who returns from a journey during Month of Ramadan, expecting to reach his family by mid-morning or later in the day.
Imam (as) said: 'If dawn rises while he is still outside (and has not yet entered his hometown), he has the option: if he wishes, he may fast, and if he wishes, he may break his fast.'"
